confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable for a second-tier Chinese provincial capital. Accommodation anchors are less certain, and July is high season for domestic summer travel in Yunnan, so nightly rates could be higher than shown. FX: the 0.6947 USD-per-AUD value came from a third-party site that attributes it to the RBA. I did not read the rba.gov.au table directly, so it is unverified against the official page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Chinese provincial capital with a tourism premium in the old-town and lakeside visitor areas, roughly in line with other inland provincial capitals such as Nanning and Guiyang, with Chengdu-style hotel pricing in the central visitor districts.
